facts.fact: Participants at a 21-22 July 2026 validation workshop in Kinshasa, including the Presidency, Prime Minister's office and Planning ministry, technically validated the draft Politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique 2026-2030, subject to integrating their recommendations.

The workshop required the final PSEN to finalise the costing of interventions, its multi-year breakdown and its link to the medium-term expenditure framework, and to complete the baseline data, indicators and annual targets, so the draft had neither a finished costing nor annual targets.
The PSEN 2026-2030 draft was technically validated at a UNDP-supported expert workshop on 21-22 July 2026.

systems.tiers: national; five orientations: sovereign infrastructure, digital transformation of the state and public services, digital economy and innovation, human capital and inclusion, trust/data governance/cybersecurity/responsible AI; aligned with the Plan national stratégique de développement and the Government Action Programme 2024-2028
